|game_text=If [[On The Hunt]] on table, deploy on a 'mark' (opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site). Target an assassin at another site. During any move phase, when reached by target, draw destiny and add target's power; opponent draws two destiny (choosing one) and adds 'mark's defense value. If your total is higher, 'mark' is 'assassinated:' opponent loses 2 Force (4 if a Jedi), 'mark' is lost, and relocate Death Mark to your side of table. Otherwise, place Death Mark (and may place assassin it targets) in Used Pile. May not be canceled. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-05-Death_Mark_Hutt_Bounty.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-deathmarkandhuttbounty-pre.gif]]). The later errata version is [[Death Mark & •Hutt Bounty (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012; the slip [[:File:VB8-05-Death_Mark_Hutt_Bounty.png]] prints it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 3, slip 10 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If On The Hunt on table, deploy on a 'mark' (opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site). Target an assassin at another site. During any move phase, when reached by target, draw destiny and add target's power; opponent draws two destiny (choosing one) and adds 'mark's defense value. If your total is higher, 'mark' is 'assassinated:' opponent loses 2 Force (4 if a Jedi), 'mark' is lost, and relocate Death Mark to your side of table. Otherwise, place Death Mark (and may place assassin it targets) in Used Pile. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-deathmarkandhuttbounty-pre.gif]]) prints the same words with the colon after the closing quotation mark (“'assassinated': opponent loses”); punctuation only, not counted as a version (held for a ruling on capitals/punctuation-only differences). The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 24) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Death Mark & •Hutt Bounty (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=24, page 24. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=24 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Mark & •Hutt Bounty (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) reads “If on the Hunt on Table”, adds “the” twice (“the 'mark' is 'assassinated': … the 'mark' is lost”) and moves the colon after the closing quotation mark. PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1281_10">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; Virtual Master list (VMasterType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “If on the Hunt on Table, deploy on a 'mark' (opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site). Target an assassin at another site. During any move phase, when reached by target, draw destiny and add target's power; opponent draws two destiny (choosing one) and adds 'mark's defense value. If your total is higher, the 'mark' is 'assassinated': opponent loses 2 Force (4 if a Jedi), the 'mark' is lost, and relocate Death Mark to your side of table. Otherwise, place Death Mark (and may place assassin it targets) in Used Pile. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” The Virtual Master list (to 11 January 2013) and the 21 July 2012 capture of VBlock8Type spell “May not be cancelled”; VBlock8Type from 12 December 2012 has “canceled”, as printed. A spelling-only difference between lists shown at the same time: this page follows the later VBlock8Type spelling, as was done for [[Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized (Errata 2)]] (held for a ruling). The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
